_comment: Project Nyra - Ultimate Claude Code Configuration with All Memory Systems

hooks.command: echo '🚀 Initializing Project Nyra Session...'
infisical run --projectId="8374cea9-e5e8-4050-bda4-b91f25ab30ef" --env="dev" --path="/shared" -- echo 'Secrets loaded'
npx claude-flow@alpha memory init --all-systems --quiet
npx ruv-swarm@latest mcp start --background
echo '✅ All memory systems initialized'
npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-command --command "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" --validate-safety true --prepare-resources true --predict-outcome true --check-patterns true --batch true --cache true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "command/pre/$CLAUDE_TIMESTAMP" --value "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" --namespace "commands" --system "ruvector" --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural predict --model "error_preventer" --input "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" --block-if-risky true --cache true
npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-edit --file "$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE" --auto-assign-agents true --load-context true --analyze-impact true --batch true --cache true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "edit/pre/$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE" --value "$CLAUDE_OPERATION_CONTEXT" --namespace "edits" --system "graphiti" --temporal true --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural optimize --operation "file-edit" --target "$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE" --suggest-improvements true --cache true

/bin/bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then CHECKPOINT_BRANCH="checkpoint/pre-edit-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; git add -A && git stash push -m "Pre-edit checkpoint for $FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git branch "$CHECKPOINT_BRANCH" && mkdir -p .claude/checkpoints && echo "{\"branch\": \"$CHECKPOINT_BRANCH\", \"file\": \"$FILE\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\", \"type\": \"pre-edit\", \"original_branch\": \"$(git branch --show-current)\"}" > ".claude/checkpoints/$(date +%s).json" && git stash pop --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && echo "✅ Created checkpoint: $CHECKPOINT_BRANCH for $FILE"; fi'
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "todos/$(date +%s)" --value "$CLAUDE_TODOS" --namespace "tasks" --system "letta" --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural predict --model "task_predictor" --input "$CLAUDE_TODOS" --optimize-order true --cache true
npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-command --command "$CLAUDE_COMMAND" --track-metrics true --store-results true --analyze-performance true --batch true

npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "command/post/$CLAUDE_TIMESTAMP" --value "{\"command\": \"$CLAUDE_COMMAND\", \"result\": \"$CLAUDE_RESULT\", \"duration\": $CLAUDE_DURATION}" --namespace "commands" --system "ruvector" --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural train --model "performance_optimizer" --data "{\"operation\": \"bash\", \"duration\": $CLAUDE_DURATION, \"success\": $CLAUDE_SUCCESS}" --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha hooks post-edit --file "$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE" --format true --update-memory true --train-neural true --analyze-quality true

npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "edit/post/$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE" --value '{"changes": $CLAUDE_CHANGES, "quality_score": $CLAUDE_QUALITY_SCORE}' --namespace "edits" --system "graphiti" --temporal true --batch true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural train --model "task_predictor" --data '{"file_type": "$CLAUDE_FILE_TYPE", "operation": "$CLAUDE_OPERATION", "success": true}' --batch true

/bin/bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git add "$FILE"; fi; if ! (git diff --cached --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null); then TAG_NAME="checkpoint-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); git add "$FILE" && git commit -m "🔖 Checkpoint: Edit $FILE" --quiet && git tag -a "$TAG_NAME" -m "Checkpoint after editing $FILE" && mkdir -p .claude/checkpoints && DIFF_STATS=$(git diff HEAD~1 --stat | tr "\n" " " | sed "s/\"/\\\\\"/g") && echo "{\"tag\": \"$TAG_NAME\", \"file\": \"$FILE\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\", \"type\": \"post-edit\", \"branch\": \"$BRANCH\", \"diff_summary\": \"$DIFF_STATS\"}" > ".claude/checkpoints/$(date +%s).json" && echo "✅ Created checkpoint: $TAG_NAME for $FILE"; else echo "ℹ️  No changes to checkpoint for $FILE"; fi; fi'
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "task/complete/$CLAUDE_TASK_ID" --value '{"task": "$CLAUDE_TASK", "agent": "$CLAUDE_AGENT", "result": "$CLAUDE_RESULT"}' --namespace "tasks" --system "letta"
npx claude-flow@alpha neural train --model "task_predictor" --data '{"task_type": "$CLAUDE_TASK_TYPE", "agent_type": "$CLAUDE_AGENT_TYPE", "performance": $CLAUDE_PERFORMANCE}'
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "prompt/$(date +%s)" --value "$CLAUDE_PROMPT" --namespace "prompts" --system "letta"
npx claude-flow@alpha neural analyze --prompt "$CLAUDE_PROMPT" --suggest-approach true --predict-complexity true

/bin/bash -c 'TASK=$(echo "{{user_prompt}}" | head -c 100 | tr "\n" " "); if [ -n "$TASK" ]; then CHECKPOINT_NAME="task-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; git add -A && git commit -m "🔖 Task checkpoint: $TASK..." --quiet || true; if command -v gh &> /dev/null; then echo "🚀 Creating GitHub release for checkpoint..."; gh release create "$CHECKPOINT_NAME" --title "Checkpoint: $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")" --notes "Task: $TASK

## Checkpoint Details
- Branch: $(git branch --show-current)
- Commit: $(git rev-parse HEAD)
- Files changed: $(git diff HEAD~1 --stat 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0) files

## Rollback Instructions
\`\`\`bash
# To rollback to this checkpoint:
git checkout $CHECKPOINT_NAME
\`\`\`" --prerelease || echo "⚠️  Failed to create GitHub release"; fi; mkdir -p .claude/checkpoints && echo "{\"checkpoint\": \"$CHECKPOINT_NAME\", \"task\": \"$TASK\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\", \"commit\": \"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\", \"github_release\": \"$(command -v gh &> /dev/null && echo true || echo false)\"}" > ".claude/checkpoints/task-$(date +%s).json" && echo "✅ Created task checkpoint: $CHECKPOINT_NAME"; fi'
npx claude-flow@alpha hooks session-end --generate-summary true --persist-state true --export-metrics true --backup-memory true --optimize-models true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory backup --all-systems --destination ".claude/memory-backup-$(date +%s).tar.gz" --compress true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory sync --systems "ruvector,letta,graphiti,mem0" --bidirectional true

/bin/bash -c 'SESSION_ID="session-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; SUMMARY_FILE=".claude/checkpoints/summary-$SESSION_ID.md"; mkdir -p .claude/checkpoints && echo "# Session Summary - $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

- Letta: $(curl -s http://localhost:8283/health | jq -r .status || echo "offline")
- Graphiti+FalkorDB: $(curl -s http://localhost:6379/ping || echo "offline")
- Mem0: $(curl -s http://localhost:8081/health | jq -r .status || echo "offline")
- OpenMemory: $(curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | jq -r .status || echo "offline")

$(find .claude/checkpoints -name "*.json" -mtime -1 -exec basename {} \; | sort)

## Files Modified
$(git diff --name-only $(git log --format=%H -n 1 --before="1 hour ago" 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null || echo "No files tracked")

## Recent Commits
$(git log --oneline -10 --grep="Checkpoint" || echo "No checkpoint commits")

# List all checkpoints
git tag -l "checkpoint-*" | sort -r

# Rollback to a checkpoint
git checkout checkpoint-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS
\`\`\`" > "$SUMMARY_FILE" && git add -A && git commit -m "🏁 Session end checkpoint: $SESSION_ID" --quiet || true && git tag -a "session-end-$SESSION_ID" -m "End of Claude session" && echo "✅ Session summary saved to: $SUMMARY_FILE" && echo "📌 Final checkpoint: session-end-$SESSION_ID"'
npx claude-flow@alpha neural train --model "all" --data "session" --comprehensive true
npx claude-flow@alpha checkpoint create --message "Auto-checkpoint: $CLAUDE_OPERATIONS_COUNT operations" --include-memory true --all-systems true
git add -A && git commit -m "🔄 Auto-checkpoint: $(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" || true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory sync --systems "all" --compress true
npx claude-flow@alpha memory store --key "error/$CLAUDE_ERROR_ID" --value '{"error": "$CLAUDE_ERROR", "context": "$CLAUDE_ERROR_CONTEXT"}' --namespace "errors" --system "graphiti" --temporal true
npx claude-flow@alpha neural train --model "error_preventer" --data '{"error_type": "$CLAUDE_ERROR_TYPE", "operation": "$CLAUDE_OPERATION", "prevent": true}'
npx claude-flow@alpha analysis error-pattern --error "$CLAUDE_ERROR" --suggest-fix true --store-pattern true --system "ruvector"
/bin/bash -c 'echo "🔄 PreCompact: Backing up to all memory systems..."; npx claude-flow@alpha memory backup --all-systems --snapshot true; echo "✅ Memory systems backed up"'
